title: Roswell witnesses describe threats made in 1947

tellings.quote: threats they'll be picking your bones out of the desert not they I had guys tell me this is what was said at the time

plain: Witnesses to the 1947 events at Roswell, New Mexico, the town where by the story a crashed craft was recovered, say they were threatened at the time to keep quiet, told that 'they'll be picking your bones out of the desert.' The UFO investigator James Fox tells Michels he heard this himself from the men: 'I had guys tell me this is what was said at the time.' If true, it would mean the military used death threats to bury what happened.
